newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X to consider Placer bid.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X to consider Placer bid.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Tuesday that it received an unsolicited offer from Placer Dome Inc and would consider the bid.
"Bre-X's board of directors, financial advisers and legal counsel will consider this offer and will respond in due course," Bre-X chief executive David Walsh said in a statement.

"While we welcome Placer's interest in our company, our highest priority remains providing for the best return for our shareholders, the Republic of Indonesia and the Indonesian people through the achieving of a satisfactory resolution of all of the issues surrounding the development of the Busang gold property," he said.
Placer Dome said earlier on Tuesday it presented a merger proposal to Bre-X to develop the huge Busang gold find in Indonesia.
The proposal involved a stock-for-stock merger, with a 40 percent equity interest going to the Indonesian government and Indonesian companies. Terms had yet to be negotiated, Placer Dome said.
Bre-X has been working on completing a deal with Toronto-based gold firm Barrick Gold Corp.
